english.title: Custody / control of a counterfeit of a protected coin - Forgery and Counterfeiting Act 1981
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, had in your custody or under your control a thing which was and which you knew or believed to be a counterfeit of a protected coin, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 16(2) and 22 of the Forgery and Counterfeiting Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful authority/excuse had in custody/under control
thing knew/believed to be a counterfeit protected coin

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 16(3) provides that it is immaterial that a coin is not in a fit state to be tendered or the making or counterfeiting of it finished or perfected.
(ii) See also offence wording: H2139.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Cadw / rheoli darn arian gwarchodedig ffug - Deddf Ffugiadau a Drwgfathu 1981
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), heb awdurdod nac esgus cyfreithlon, roedd gennych yn eich gofal neu dan eich rheolaeth rywbeth a oedd yn ddarn arian gwarchodedig ffug, a chithau'n gwybod neu'n credu hynny, sef **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 16(2) a 22 Deddf Ffugiadau a Drwgfathu 1981.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
